boot.deck.en: Two rooms, two tables, neither able to see the other. Every hull you lose salvages a heavier weapon, so the fleet that is burning is the one with options.
boot.deck.sl: Dve sobi, dve mizi, nobena ne vidi druge. Vsaka potopljena ladja ti prinese težje orožje, zato ima gorečo floto tisti, ki ima na voljo več možnosti.

lobby.deck.en: Send this code. The match starts the moment they sit down.
lobby.deck.sl: Pošlji to kodo. Igra se začne takoj, ko nasprotnik sede.

seats.title.sl: TA SOBA JE ŽE NA MORJU

seats.deck.en: If one of these was you, take the seat back.
seats.deck.sl: Če je eden od teh tvoj, prevzemi svoj sedež nazaj.

place.hint.en: Pick a hull, then tap the plot to berth it. Tap a berthed hull to lift it again.
place.hint.sl: Izberi ladjo in se dotakni mreže, da jo zasidraš. Dotakni se zasidrane ladje, da jo spet dvigneš.

hint.fire.en: One shell. Pick a cell, then give the order.
hint.fire.sl: Ena granata. Izberi polje, nato ukaži.

hint.sonar.en: Pick a centre. You learn how many hulls are in the block, never which.
hint.sonar.sl: Izberi središče. Izvedel boš, koliko ladij je v bloku, nikoli katerih.

hint.decoy.en: Drop it on your own open water. A shell there reads as a hit, for good.
hint.decoy.sl: Postavi jo na svoje prazno morje. Granata tam se bere kot zadetek, za vedno.

hint.barrage.en: Three shells in a line from the cell you pick. TURN swings it.
hint.barrage.sl: Tri granate v vrsti od izbranega polja. OBRNI jo zasuka.

hint.reposition.en: Pick an undamaged hull, then a fresh berth. TURN swings it.
hint.reposition.sl: Izberi nepoškodovano ladjo, nato novo mesto. OBRNI jo zasuka.

hint.depthCharge.en: Nine cells at once. It damages and surveys.
hint.depthCharge.sl: Devet polj naenkrat. Poškoduje in razišče.

over.wonLine.sl: {who} nima več nobene ladje na površju.

toast.seatTaken.sl: Nekdo drug je prevzel ta sedež

toast.abandoned.en: The other fleet left. The match is void.
toast.abandoned.sl: Nasprotna flota je odšla. Igra je razveljavljena.

refuse.offPlot.en: That is not on the plot

refuse.locked.en: Lose a hull of your own first

refuse.tooManyDecoys.en: You already have two buoys out
refuse.tooManyDecoys.sl: Na vodi imaš že dve boji

refuse.overlap.en: Two hulls cannot share a cell
refuse.overlap.sl: Dve ladji ne moreta deliti polja

refuse.badFleet.en: That is not a whole fleet

refuse.notPlacing.en: Fleets are not being laid right now

refuse.nameTaken.en: That name is taken in this room
refuse.nameTaken.sl: To ime je v tej sobi že zasedeno

refuse.badName.sl: Ime naj ima od 1 do 20 znakov

rules.intro.en: Classic battleship has one problem: whoever finds a hull first usually just wins, and all the skill sits in the ten seconds of placement at the start. This version keeps the race to find hulls, and gives the fleet that is losing it the tools to fight back.
rules.intro.sl: Klasično potapljanje ladjic ima eno težavo: kdor prvi najde ladjo, običajno preprosto zmaga, vsa spretnost pa je v desetih sekundah razpostavljanja na začetku. Ta različica ohrani tekmo v iskanju ladij, floti, ki izgublja, pa da orodja, da se upre.

rules.turn.en: One action each, in turn. An aimed shell that hits fires again, so a hull you have found costs you one turn to finish, however long it is. A tool always ends your turn, even when it hits: an action is either a free shell or one tool, paid for with salvage, and that trade is where the game lives.
rules.turn.sl: Vsak po eno dejanje, izmenično. Usmerjena granata, ki zadene, strelja še enkrat, zato te najdena ladja stane eno potezo, ne glede na dolžino. Orodje vedno konča tvojo potezo, tudi ko zadene: dejanje je bodisi brezplačna granata bodisi eno orodje, plačano s plenom, in prav ta kompromis je bistvo igre.

rules.salvage.en: Salvage pays for damage you take, not damage you deal. Every shell that lands on your fleet pays you {hit}, and {behind} more while you have lost more hulls than they have, so bad luck funds its own reply. The gunner is paid for finishing the job instead: sinking a whole ship pays the hunter {bounty}, while hits scattered across hulls that are still afloat pay the hunter nothing. Both fleets start with none, and salvage stops at {cap}, so hoarding it buys nothing.
rules.salvage.sl: Plen dobiš za škodo, ki jo prejmeš, ne za škodo, ki jo narediš. Vsaka granata, ki zadene tvojo floto, ti prinese {hit}, in še {behind} več, dokler si izgubil več ladij kot nasprotnik, zato smola financira svoj odgovor. Strelec je plačan šele, ko delo dokonča: potopljena ladja lovcu prinese {bounty}, raztreseni zadetki po ladjah, ki še plujejo, pa mu ne prinesejo ničesar. Obe floti začneta brez plena, plen pa se ustavi pri {cap}, zato kopičenje ne prinese ničesar.

rules.ladder.en: The heavy tools are not bought with a lead, they are salvaged out of your own wrecks. A fleet that is winning fights with a sweep and a buoy. Lose one hull and the barrage and the reberth open; lose two and you get the depth charge. Losing hulls on purpose is a real line, and a losing one: the ladder buys access, not salvage and not turns.
rules.ladder.sl: Težkih orodij ne kupiš s prednostjo, temveč jih rešiš iz lastnih razbitin. Flota, ki zmaguje, se bori s sonarjem in bojo. Izgubi eno ladjo in odpreta se salva in prestavljanje; izgubi dve in dobiš globinsko bombo. Namerno izgubljanje ladij je resnična taktika, a poražena: lestvica ti da dostop, ne plena in ne potez.

rules.rung.en: after {n} of your own hulls go down

rules.sonar.en: Names a three by three and tells you how many hulls are inside it, never which. It costs you something too: the fleet under it is told where you looked.
rules.sonar.sl: Označi polje tri krat tri in ti pove, koliko ladij je v njem, nikoli katerih. Nekaj te tudi stane: flota pod njim izve, kam si pogledal.

rules.decoy.en: A buoy on your own open water. The shell that finds it reads as a hit on their plot, and it stays a hit for the rest of the match. It pays you like a hull would, so the tote board does not give it away. They can only rule it out by boxing it in with misses, or by sweeping it: sonar never counts a buoy.
rules.decoy.sl: Boja na tvojem praznem morju. Granata, ki jo najde, se na njihovi karti bere kot zadetek in zadetek ostane do konca igre. Izplača ti enako kot prava ladja, da je semafor ne izda. Izločijo jo lahko le tako, da jo obkrožijo z zgrešenimi streli, ali s sonarjem: sonar boje nikoli ne šteje.

rules.barrage.en: Three shells in a straight line, in one turn. It damages what it touches but does not survey the water: a cell it found empty still has to be searched properly.
rules.barrage.sl: Tri granate v ravni vrsti, v eni potezi. Poškoduje, kar zadene, a vode ne razišče: polje, ki ga je našla prazno, je treba še vedno pravilno preiskati.

rules.reposition.en: Move an undamaged hull to fresh water. A hull they have already touched is pinned, and the new berth cannot use a cell they have searched. They are told a hull moved, never which or where.
rules.reposition.sl: Prestavi nepoškodovano ladjo na svežo vodo. Ladja, ki so se je že dotaknili, je priklenjena, novo mesto pa ne sme uporabiti polja, ki so ga že preiskali. Izvedo, da se je ladja premaknila, nikoli katera ali kam.

rules.depthCharge.en: Nine cells at once, and it surveys them: the water it churns is plotted as missed. Only a fleet with two hulls of its own on the bottom can drop one, which is what makes it the comeback.
rules.depthCharge.sl: Devet polj naenkrat, in jih razišče: voda, ki jo razburka, se označi kot zgrešena. Spusti jo lahko le flota, ki ima na dnu že dve svoji ladji, in prav zato je orodje za preobrat.
